slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A central angle has its vertex at the center. A minor arc is less than half a circle and its measure is the measure of its central angle. A major arc measures 360 minus its minor arc. A semicircle measures 180 degrees.

Arc Addition Postulate: the measure of an arc made of two adjacent arcs is the sum of their measures. In one circle (or congruent circles), equal central angles have equal arcs and equal chords.

Arc measure is in degrees; arc length (11.6) is a distance.
